title: Envoy dropouts: half follow HA restarts, half spontaneous; the Envoy itself stops answering - Realtime paused, trial readout next
summary: 7 days: 18 dropouts >15 min (up to 268 min). 8 began within 60 min after an HA start (all of today's deploys); 10 spontaneous, mostly nights. In 7 of 10 long dropouts since install, ha-enphase-realtime was also blind - the box stopped answering, so integration choice cannot fix it. Operator: 'no stream integration will be more reliable than the underlying hardware.' Realtime paused (disabled) 10-09; nothing consumed its _2 entities.
why: Operator first asked to auto-reload on stuck state, then ruled 'Don't build. Measure.' Measurement showed reloads only wait out an unresponsive Envoy.
implications: Batch deploys into fewer restarts. Parked O3 (replace core enphase_envoy with realtime) now hinges only on restart time-to-first-value - formal trial readout per PLANNING_ec_enphase_resilience_and_p1_adjust §7.3 decides it.
alternatives_considered: Periodic auto-reload watchdog - not built (would only wait out the box)
revisit_trigger: Pause shows dropout counts drop materially, or trial readout shows realtime recovers far faster after restarts.
